findings.observation: The silver topknot and general face outline connect to Orar, but the summon’s mature eye scale, cheek planes, narrow upper lip, and age-38 cues drift into enlarged doll-like eyes, a shortened small nose, very smooth cheeks, and a substantially younger-looking face; exact adult identity is not preserved.
The compact chibi retains Orar’s soft rounded middle, medium-width shoulders, gentle limb construction, and grounded posture without turning her torso into an athletic or heavily muscular build.
Both forearms, wrists, and clenched hands are visibly thicker and blockier relative to the torso than in the summon, producing the generic arm-and-hand inflation prohibited by the target.
The gray-white-silver front sweep, wrapped gathered mass, dark lowlights, architectural high knot, and bound-loop silhouette remain clearly traceable to the summon.

The moss-ivory wrap construction, architectural lapel, rolled sleeves, layered panels, off-center tie, divided trousers, soft boots, thread spool, and botanical shoulder tattoo remain present with consistent palette relationships.
Original-resolution inspection estimates the complete topknot-through-chin unit at roughly 37 percent of standing topknot-through-sole height, slightly above the required 32–36 percent range.
Exactly one subject is present, and the complete high knot, both hands, both trouser legs, and both boots remain visible inside comfortable margins.
The wide grounded stance, compact silhouette, separated boots, readable wrap layers, and empty ready hands remain legible at combat-icon scale.
The image contains ordinary cloth workwear and personal anchors only, with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, affinity cue, aura, glow, gem, frame, star, UI, text, or supernatural effect.
